Public Records

The Records Section processes requests under Chapter 119, Florida Statutes.

Submit a public records request online

Questions: publicrecords@mockingbirdsheriff.gov. Records phone: (555) 555-0142

Fees: Copies are $0.15 per page. Body worn camera video requiring redaction is charged a special service charge of $32.50 per hour of staff time.

Body worn camera recordings are released in accordance with section 119.071(2)(l).
